name: Utkatasana
description: A powerful standing squat that generates heat, strengthens the legs, and engages the core.
benefits: Strengthens ankles, thighs, calves, and spine

steps.instruction: Stand tall with feet together, arms relaxed by your side.
steps.voice_prompt: Stand tall with your feet together, body relaxed and upright.

steps.instruction: Inhale, raise your heels and raise your arms to shoulder level.
steps.voice_prompt: Inhale, raise your heels up off the floor and raise your arms up to shoulder level.

steps.instruction: Turn your palms down, exhale, and slowly squat down halfway.
steps.voice_prompt: Turn your palms down. Exhale, and slowly squat down halfway as if sitting on a chair.

steps.instruction: Keep spine in line, stretch arms forward, and breathe.
steps.voice_prompt: Keep your back straight, arms extended forward, and hold the pose while breathing.

steps.instruction: Inhale, come up slowly, lower heels, and release arms.
steps.voice_prompt: Inhale, slowly stand back up, lower your heels, and relax your arms down.
